name: Crypto cross-sectional long-short 24-hour lagged return rank
author: Fracassi, Lee, Kogan
entry_long: Long the two cryptocurrencies with lowest 24-lagged 1-hour returns
entry_short: Short the two with highest 24-lagged 1-hour returns
position_sizing: Equal-weight two long and two short legs per paper summary
claimed_performance: Paper abstract reports very high annualized gross return and Sharpe before costs; high turnover makes costs material.
implementation_notes: Source labels the signal pure momentum though the stated low/high ordering is counterintuitive; verify sign convention against full tables before implementation.
